reference.title: Soybean root literature-derived marker panel · Zhang et al., Table S2
reference.coverage: 41 distinct genes, 9 root cell types; authors' Root-column assignments from the literature-derived panel. Contains soybean evidence and Arabidopsis orthology-derived markers; not an independently validated classifier.

provenance.genomeBuildEvidence: Source Methods P64 reports Williams 82 v4. Table S2 was compiled and applied by these authors to that analysis. This imports their exact gene IDs and root assignments; it does not establish a universal cross-build mapping.
provenance.extraction: Exact spreadsheet rows; underscores converted to spaces only in displayed cell-type names. Duplicate gene/type associations count once. Full source workbooks remain in ignored local storage.
provenance.rights: Factual marker associations and numerical data extracted; article prose and full workbooks are not redistributed.

corroboration.purpose: Same-study de-novo marker corroboration only; excluded from annotation scoring and not independent validation.
